--- a/app/services/users.py
+++ b/app/services/users.py
@@ -5,3 +5,12 @@
 
 def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
     return store.get_by_id(user_id)
+
+
+def search_users(query: str) -> list[dict]:
+    query = query.lower()
+    results = []
+    for user in store._USERS.values():
+        if query in user["name"].lower() or query in user["email"].lower():
+            results.append(user)
+    return sorted(results, key=lambda u: u["id"])

--- a/app/api/handlers.py
+++ b/app/api/handlers.py
@@ -11,3 +11,12 @@
     if user is None:
         return 404, {"error": "not found"}
     return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_search_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("q")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid query"}
+    
+    results = users.search_users(raw.strip())
+    return 200, {"users": results}

--- a/tests/test_search.py
+++ b/tests/test_search.py
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+from app.api.handlers import handle_search_users
+
+def test_search_users_ok():
+    status, data = handle_search_users({"q": "ad"})
+    assert status == 200
+    assert data == {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}
+
+    status, data = handle_search_users({"q": "example"})
+    assert status == 200
+    assert len(data["users"]) == 2
+
+def test_search_users_invalid():
+    assert handle_search_users({})[0] == 400
+    assert handle_search_users({"q": ""})[0] == 400
+    assert handle_search_users({"q": "  "})[0] == 400
+    assert handle_search_users({"q": 123})[0] == 400
